key_reasoning.reason: Two modified components in the analytics service (the shared AggregationBuilder helper in aggregation_builder.py and WorkflowHandler in handlers/workflow_handler.py), plus two test modules. The change to the shared helper raises scope to L. Single layer (Service), no new abstractions.

Changes Elasticsearch terms-aggregation ordering (single dict order replaced by a list with a _key tie-breaker) and adds a Painless script option to build_terms_agg. Ordering drives fetch-and-slice pagination correctness, so a regression would shift pages. An existing pattern (list order support, top_workflow_usage ordering) covers the approach, so risk stays M.
Acceptance criteria are encoded in the tests: workflows order by unique_executions desc then _key asc; top_workflow_usage keeps its 1-bucket order. No open decisions.
